title: Tests: RemotePinClient with mock HTTP server
description:
What: Test RemotePinClient against a mock HTTP server.

Algorithm:
1. Add wiremock = '0.6' to [dev-dependencies] in crates/transit/Cargo.toml
2. Write tests in crates/transit/src/retention/remote_pin_client.rs #[cfg(test)] block:

Setup pattern (use wiremock or axum in-process):
- Spin up a MockServer
- Register response templates for /pins and /pins/{id}
- Create RemotePinClient pointing at mock server URL
- Note: mock server must provide HTTP (not HTTPS) — for tests, allow http:// by making the HTTPS-only validation optional or test-only. Alternative: if wiremock uses http://, skip HTTPS validation in tests by adding a test constructor that accepts http://.

Tests:
1. submit_pin_success: POST /pins returns 202 with {requestid: 'req1', status: 'queued', pin: {cid: '...'}} -> Ok(RemotePin { request_id: 'req1', status: Queued })
2. submit_pin_rate_limited: POST /pins returns 429 with Retry-After: 30 -> Err(RateLimited(30))
3. submit_pin_unauthorized: POST /pins returns 401 -> Err(ServiceError(401, ...))
4. check_status_pinned: GET /pins/req1 returns {status: 'pinned'} -> Ok(RemotePin { status: Pinned })
5. check_status_failed: GET /pins/req1 returns {status: 'failed'} -> Ok(RemotePin { status: Failed })
6. check_status_not_found: GET /pins/req1 returns 404 -> Err(ServiceError(404, ...))
7. api_key_not_in_logs: verify api key does not appear in any error message string (Debug output of RemotePinError variants)

All test vector responses are hardcoded JSON strings matching the IPFS Remote Pinning API spec format.
